profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta, ex-AWS
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I'm an expert full-stack and systems developer with experience in Java, Python, React, TypeScript, and Node. I am also a natural leader who has designed APIs, data stores, pipelines, and full products. I have been an SDE at Amazon for 3 years and an SDE at Meta for 2 years. One of my largest impact products has been designing and implementing the GPU Failure Handing System for the Kubernetes cluster for Anthropic Claude on Bedrock.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI
positions.description:
- Streamlined the benchmarking for our model task workflow, saving developer time and compute resources
- Designed complex engineering tasks for benchmarking and training Meta's frontier AI model

positions.title: Software Engineer - Instagram Graph
positions.description:
- Full-stack engineer developing in Django, Hack, and Android (Java/Kotlin) for Instagram Friendship
- Wrote Claude skills to automate internal migration processes
- Led large-scale migration of server infrastructure for Instagram Friending APIs
- Led collaboration across four teams for a redesign of the Suggested Users in Instagram Stories Tray

positions.title: Software Engineer II - AWS Bedrock (ML/AI)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Full-stack dev using Java, Python, Typescript, and Kubernetes
- Designed the GPU Failure Handler for Bedrock K8s hosting for Claude
- Re-architected the Bedrock Document Parser using a MicroVM on ECS
- Designed Fraud event handling for resource isolation/termination
- Created AppConfig pipelines to reduce ops load and enable features
- Launched model conversation API for models with custom weights

positions.title: Software Engineer - AWS Supply Chain
positions.description:
- Full-stack dev using Java, Python, React, Typescript, MySQL, and Ruby
- Launched a microservice with AWS Cloud infrastructure, like DynamoDB
- Designed and implemented projects including API, datastore, and Auth
- Orchestrated a project to introduce new attributes to 4 different services
- Code review lead with most reviews, comments, and approvals on team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- On the small dev team for TiCrypt, an encryption-heavy research suite
- Developed features in Go for the Virtual Machine controller of TiCrypt

positions.description:

- Wrote end-to-end and integration tests in a Selenium-based language

- Wrote unit and integration tests in Ava, Jest, Sinon, and Mocha
